title: Quarterly roadmap: Hosted endpoints flight-plan & commitment buffer playbook
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: Produce a prescriptive quarterly playbook that ties hosted endpoint commitments (capacity lanes, reserved runway) to model catalog rotations and OKR targets. This ticket scopes the roadmap alignment work, the commitment lattice (what we promise to customers vs internal buffer), and the decision rules for tranches, canaries, and emergency fallbacks.

Scope:
- Define commitment tiers (SLA-backed lanes, soft-reserve lanes, opportunistic lanes) and mapping to model families.
- Produce a capacity runway plan for Q2 that quantifies reserved GPU-hours and burst buckets by lane.
- Create gating rules for model rotations: health checks, latency/cost regression thresholds, and rollback thresholds.
- Draft OKR-aligned success metrics and signal thresholds for Automatic Fallback policies.
- Deliverables: one-page playbook, capacity spreadsheet (CSV), rollout checklist, and a runbook for outages/forced rollbacks.

Success metrics (linked to OKRs):
- Model rotation failure rate <= 2% during canaries.
- 99.5% of requests served at target latency for SLA lanes.
- Unit token cost within 10% of projection for reserved lanes in first 30 days.
- On-call incidents attributable to model rotation < 1 per quarter.

Acceptance criteria:
- Playbook approved by Eng, Infra, and SRE leads.
- Capacity spreadsheet accepted by Finance and Infra with committed reserve values.
- Automated gating jobs created as GH issues and linked to this ticket.
- Canary rollout runbook validated in staging and dry-run executed.

Stakeholders: PM (Maya Chen), Product Lead (Rafael Ortega), Infra Eng (Nadia Singh), SRE (Omar Haddad), Finance (Leah Brooks), Ops (Team: Dedicated/Ops).
